systems.name: Brake System
systems.desc: High-performance brake components built for maximum stopping power, durability and reliability. Designed to meet or exceed industry standards for safe and dependable operation on every mile.

parts.title: Spring Brake Chamber
parts.desc: High-performance spring brake chambers built for durability and consistent braking force. Designed for service and parking brake applications, ensuring maximum safety and reliability.
features: High-strength steel housing for long service life
Powerful spring force for secure parking

parts.title: Heavy Duty Brake Drum
parts.desc: Precision-engineered brake drums designed for heavy-duty applications. Built with high-quality cast iron for superior heat dissipation, strength and wear resistance.
features: Premium grade cast iron for maximum durability
Precision machining for proper fit and balance
Superior heat dissipation for extended life

parts.title: Automatic Slack Adjuster
parts.desc: Automatic slack adjusters that keep brake stroke in spec and cut down on manual adjustment.

systems.name: Air System
systems.desc: Premium, high-performance air system components for semi-trailers. Valves, tanks, gladhands, hose and fittings that keep the whole air circuit sealed and responsive.

parts.title: Relay Valve
parts.desc: Relay valves for fast, consistent air delivery to the brake chambers.

parts.title: Gladhands & Coiled Airline
parts.desc: Bracket-mount and conventional gladhands, seals, and 12-15 ft coiled airline.

systems.name: Suspension System
systems.desc: Suspension components designed to deliver a smoother ride, improve stability and extend the life of your trailer. Air springs, shocks, leaf springs and slider parts.

parts.title: Air Spring (Rolling Lobe)
parts.desc: Air springs for Neway, Hendrickson, Reyco and Hutch suspensions, cross-referenced to industry numbers.

parts.title: Shock Absorber
parts.desc: Heavy-duty shock absorbers for trailer air-ride suspensions.

systems.name: Hydraulic System
systems.desc: Hydraulic components built for strength, precision and long-lasting performance in the toughest conditions. Cylinders, pumps, hose and fittings.

parts.title: Hydraulic Cylinder & Pump Set
parts.spec: Call with VIN to confirm fit

parts.title: Roof Bow

parts.title: Door Hinge & Lockrod Parts

systems.name: Hardware & Fasteners
